research_status: COMPLETE — all 291 episodes of Dragon Ball Z classified canon/filler/mixed. Sourced from two independently-fetched filler guides (OtakusNotes, SuperHeroJacked) whose breakdowns matched almost exactly (both agree on all 38 pure-filler episodes and the vast majority of the canon range), diverging only on episodes 17-20 and 44 — resolved in favor of the mixed classification (OtakusNotes' call) for all four, corroborated by two further independently-fetched sources: CBR specifically confirms 11/17/18/20/204/251/287 as mixed, and ScreenRant specifically confirms 44 as mixed. Episode 229 is the one mixed episode with only a single directly-fetched source behind it — flagged in its own status_note rather than silently treated as equally corroborated as the rest. No episode titles included in this file — matches this project's established pattern of leaving title backfill to backfill_episode_titles_from_anilist.py (#73) after loading, rather than hand-typing 291 titles here. Complete, gap-free, non-overlapping coverage of 1–291 confirmed before writing this file.

citation_sources.description: OtakusNotes' Dragon Ball Z filler list — full episode-by-episode classification into manga canon, mixed canon/filler, and pure filler.

SuperHeroJacked's Dragon Ball Z filler list and watch guide — matched OtakusNotes' breakdown almost exactly, disagreeing only on episodes 17-20 (treated as straight canon rather than mixed) and episode 44 (treated as pure filler rather than mixed).
CBR feature on Dragon Ball Z's semi-canon/mixed episodes — independently corroborates OtakusNotes' mixed-episode calls for episodes 11, 17, 18, 20, 204, 251, and 287.

ScreenRant's Dragon Ball Z filler guide — corroborates OtakusNotes on episodes 9-16 as filler, and specifically confirms episode 44 as mixed (the tail end of the Fake Namek filler material plus the start of real canon content).

episodes.status_note: Cross-source disagreement: OtakusNotes and ScreenRant both call this episode mixed (it closes out the Fake Namek filler material and opens real canon content in the same episode), while SuperHeroJacked's otherwise-agreeing guide lumps it in with the preceding pure filler run (39-43) instead. Going with mixed, 2 sources vs 1.

Only directly confirmed as mixed by one fetched guide (OtakusNotes); unlike this dataset's other mixed episodes, no second source was found that specifically addresses this episode to corroborate it — flagged here rather than silently treated as equally well-sourced.
